name: Catfish: The TV Show
description: Nev and his co-hosts -- from Max to Kamie to celebrity guests -- help people in dubious online relationships track down their baes IRL so they can sort out what's fact and what's fiction.

videos.title: Reunion Special
videos.overview: Participants from Catfish: The TV Show reunite in MTV's Times Square studio to answer questions from fans. The show is hosted by Nev and Max, and Su-Chin Pak.

videos.title: Hooked On Catfish: The Road To Season 2
videos.overview: Max and Nev take us behind the scenes and give us a sneak peek at what to expect when Season 2 premieres.

videos.title: Chatfish Live After Show: Lauren & Derek
videos.overview: Lauren and Derek join Su-chin, Nev and Max to answer fan questions and dish on how their relationship is today.

videos.title: Chatfish Live After Show: Dorion & Jeszica
videos.overview: Dorion, Raffinee and Alexis are all together for the first time to discuss their love triangle on the Live After Show.

videos.title: Mid-Season Reunion
videos.overview: Participants from the second season of Catfish: The TV Show reunite in MTV's Times Square studio to answer questions from fans, Catfish investigators Nev and Max, and host SuChin Pak. Sparks fly when several of the Catfish alums face each other for the first time since appearing on the series.

videos.title: Catfish Season 2: Last Hooks
videos.overview: Nev and Max give us a behind-the-scenes look at filming season 2 of 'Catfish: The TV Show.'

videos.title: Chatfish Live After Show

videos.title: Nev and Max's 15 Craziest Catfish Moments Ever
videos.overview: Take a dive into the Catfish archives with Nev and Max, as they count down their favorite jaw-dropping moments from the first three seasons of Catfish in this entertaining 60-minute special. Besides getting to re-live the shocks, surprises, and twists and turns that have been hallmarks of the series, viewers will also get a load of great behind the scenes insights from Catfish's intrepid hosts?

Stephanie & David [Unseen Episode]
videos.overview: After Stephanie's parents' divorce, she began to question whether she could ever trust a man in a relationship. But then she met David online and immediately developed a deep bond with him. Nev and Max help Stephanie find the man she's been talking to in an unseen episode from the first season.

Where Are They Now?

videos.overview: Hosted by Nev Schulman and Max Joseph, Catfish: The Untold Stories, features three never-before-seen shocking but true catfish tales, as told by the people who actually experienced them.

videos.overview: Hosted by Nev Schulman and Max Joseph, Catfish: The Untold Stories, features three never-before-seen shocking but true catfish tales, as told by the people who actually experienced them.

videos.title: Best Moments Ever
videos.overview: Memorable moments in the show's history are revisited.

videos.title: The Ones That Got Away
videos.overview: In this special episode of Catfish, Nev and Max reunite past Catfish and their victims who parted on bad terms to follow up on what life has been like since the show and to help them find a better resolution.

videos.title: Top Ten Holy S*@#! Catfish Moments
Hooked on Love
videos.overview: Nev and Max reminisce about happy highlights in the first five seasons, and countdown the ten most amorous moments.

videos.title: Still Hooked!
videos.overview: Nev and Max follow up with catfish and their victims from some of the most memorable episodes. We hear what life has been like since filming and learn if these former online relationships have a chance at surviving in real life!

videos.title: The Untold Stories, Part 9
videos.overview: Catfish: The Untold Stories features three shocking catfish stories from the recent past as told by the people who actually experienced them.

videos.title: The Untold Stories, Part 10
videos.overview: Catfish: The Untold Stories features real-life shocking catfish tales from the recent past, including one never before told story by Nev, of how he was Catfished again!

videos.title: It's a Cat Cat Cat Catfish World
videos.overview: Nev and Max take viewers on a journey through the history of Catfish, beginning with the original documentary. From hilarious star-studded parodies to amazing fan art, they explore the effect the show has had on pop culture.

videos.title: Liar Liar Catfish on Fire
videos.overview: CTG wraps are used to introduce the top 20 biggest lies that have ever been told on Catfish.

videos.title: When Catfish Broke the Internet
videos.overview: Charlamagne Tha God dives headfirst into the twittersphere to find some of the wildest, funniest, and outright insane comments and memes you have made during iconic Catfish moments.

videos.title: What Kind of Catfish Are You?
videos.overview: Nev breaks down the different species of Catfish, from the Cheaters, to the Scammers and the Revenge Artists, as he counts down some of the show's wildest moments.

videos.title: To Catch a Catfish
videos.overview: Feel the thrill of the hunt as hosts Nev and Charlamagne tha God relive the most exciting pursuits, craziest investigative tricks, and greatest lengths Nev and Max have gone to…TO CATCH A CATFISH!

videos.title: Catfish Keeps It 100: Dear Nev & Max
videos.overview: Nev and Max read and respond to a wide variety of fan emails, answering questions and dishing out advice on topics ranging from love triangles to telepathy.

videos.title: Catfish Keeps It 100: the Young and the Catfished
videos.overview: Nev and Max count down the Top Ten Crazy “Teenage Episodes” in Catfish History, as well as share hilarious and embarrassing stories from their own mischievous teenage years.

videos.title: Catfish Keeps It 100: Catfish Breaks the Internet Again
videos.overview: Charlamagne Tha God is back to explore even more of the craziest, most tweet-worthy Catfish moments that set the cybersphere on fire! Join him as Catfish Breaks the Internet....AGAIN!

videos.title: Catfish Keeps It 100: The Aftershock
videos.overview: In a new “Catfish Keeps it 100” special episode, Nev and Max count down the most surprising and explosive “Follow-up Meetings” in Catfish history. When the shock of meeting the catfish in person wears off, things get real!

videos.title: Catfish Keeps It 100: Top 10 Most Wanted
videos.overview: In a new “Catfish Keeps it 100” special episode, Nev and Max count down the Top Ten most heartless catfish from the past six seasons. From con artists to nude photo collectors, these devious catfish are in a class all their own!

videos.title: Catfish Keeps It 100: Creepy Catfish Countdown
videos.overview: From Scary Superfans to paranormal parents, Nev and Max count down the Top Ten most bizarre and hair raising moments in Catfish history.

videos.title: Catfish Keeps It 100: Where Are They Now?
videos.overview: Nev and Max revisit past episodes and video chat with several former “hopefuls” and “catfish” to find out how their lives have changed since appearing on the show.

videos.title: Catfish Keeps it 100: Charlamagne's Favorite F**king Catfish Moments
videos.overview: Radio host and friend of the show, Charlamagne tha God, shares his "favorite f'ing moments" from seasons past. From a boxing match to crusty boxers, Charlamagne brings the funny!

videos.title: Catfish Trolls: Miss Mia Rose & Maldiva
videos.overview: Charlamagne Tha God and Raymond Braun help a female gamer and Twitch streamer confront a misogynistic troll who's been harassing her online for years.

videos.title: Catfish Trolls: Camyonce & Rollin’ Ray
videos.overview: Cameron is at his wits end with a wheelchair-bound troll named “Rollin’ Ray”. When Charlamagne and Raymond finally arrange a meeting between the two, tempers flare and their long-awaited confrontation becomes explosive.

videos.title: Catfish Trolls: Ciera & Eskimo Jay
videos.overview: Ciera's life changes when a troll named Eskimo Jay steals her selfies and creates an offensive meme that instantly goes viral. Hurt, angry and embarrassed, Ciera teams up with Charlamagne and Raymond to confront her aggressor.

videos.title: Making Waves: Ten Years of Catfish
videos.overview: From shocking reveals and twist happy endings to strange emails and countless red flags, look back on the most memorable moments in a decade of DMs on this special Catfish retrospective.

videos.title: Catfish: Sweet & Sour
videos.overview: Take a walk down memory lane as Catfish hosts Nev and Kamie reflect on the super sweet and shockingly sour moments they have witnessed over the years.

videos.title: Sunny & Jamison
videos.overview: Nursing student Sunny met and fell in love with model "Jamison" or "RJ" while chatting on Facebook, but they had never met in the 8 months they had talked.

videos.title: Trina & Scorpio
videos.overview: Exotic dancer Shawnise aka Trina, met fellow exotic dancer Lee aka "Scorpio" on MySpace and had been talking for over a year and never met.

videos.title: Kim & Matt
videos.overview: Kim had been talking to Matt for over 10 years when she contacted Nev for help to meet him. She is in a relationship with a man named Scott, who knows about Matt. Kim opens up to Nev that the love of her life Steven committed suicide and that Matt helped her through the grief.

videos.title: Jasmine & Mike
videos.overview: Jasmine had been texting "Mike" for 2 years, though they had never met or talked on the phone.

videos.title: Jarrod & Abby
videos.overview: Jarrod is a divorced father from Georgia who met and fell for a blonde girl on Facebook named "Abby". Jarrod told Nev that he had even proposed to Abby and she said yes.

videos.title: Kya & Alyx
videos.overview: When Kya first met "Alyx" online, she used a fake name and fake pictures. She later told him the truth and Alyx forgave her. Nev helps Kya finally meet Alyx, who she says she has fallen in love with but has never actually met.

videos.title: Joe & Kari Ann
videos.overview: Nev helps Joe meet the girl he's been talking to who says she is former Miss United States Teen 2003, Kari Ann.

videos.title: Tyler & Amanda
videos.overview: Tyler has fallen for "Amanda" when he asks Nev for help. When Tyler tells his friends about her, they are all surprised it was with a girl from online.

videos.title: Rod & Ebony
videos.overview: Rod hasn't been honest with "Ebony" about what he looks like or his name, which he told her is "KJ" in the 4 years they have been talking.

videos.title: Rico & Ja'Mari
videos.overview: Rico lives in the United States but is torn on whether or not to continue his online relationship with a man named "Ja'mari" or move to England to be with his ailing mother.

videos.title: Mike & Felicia
videos.overview: Mike and Felicia met online and soon hit it off. After agreeing to meet, Felicia stood Mike up, offering only thin excuses.

videos.title: Cassie & Steve
videos.overview: Cassie's life was on a downward spiral of alcohol, drug abuse, and promiscuity after her father's brutal murder. Then one day she received a Facebook message from Steve and he became the positive influence she needed, teaching her to love herself and improve her lifestyle. Their relationship intensified and Cassie even asked Steve to marry her—and Steve accepted. Cassie desperately wants to meet her fiancé, but Steve is always too busy to video chat, let alone get together with her. They find out that Steve is actually Cassie's best friend Gladys, and Gladys' cousin, who wanted to help get Cassie's life back on track after all other efforts failed

videos.title: Anthony & Marq
videos.overview: An Iraq War veteran bonds with a man online.

videos.title: Ramon & Paola
videos.overview: A man becomes suspicious of a woman he met on Facebook.

videos.title: Lauren & Derek
videos.overview: A woman becomes suspicious of a man she met on Myspace when he avoids meeting her in person.

videos.title: Dorion & Jeszica
videos.overview: A man considers leaving his girlfriend for a woman he met online.

videos.title: Jen & Skylar
videos.overview: A former bullying victim relies on online communities to establish relationships.

videos.title: Mike & Kristen
videos.overview: A man struggles to arrange an in-person meeting with a woman he met on Facebook.

videos.title: Jesse & Brian
videos.overview: A woman who was stood up by a man she met online wonders why he now wants to live with her.

videos.title: Artis & Jess
videos.overview: Relationships are put at risk when a man and a woman meet online.

videos.title: Ashley & Mike
videos.overview: A woman sends altered photos of herself to a man she met online.

videos.title: Aaliyah & Alicia
videos.overview: Alicia refuses to meet Aaliyah because she has not come out to her friends and family.

videos.title: Nick & Melissa
videos.overview: Nick and Melissa fell in love when they met on an online chat room when they were 12. Now 18, Nick is ready to finally ready to meet Melissa. But is Melissa the real deal or has Nick been entangled in lies?

videos.title: Derek & Kristen
videos.overview: A hapless man falls for a woman he met on Facebook.

videos.title: Keyonnah & Bow Wow
videos.overview: A woman thinks she's in an online relationship with rapper Bow Wow.

videos.title: Mike & Caroline
videos.overview: A man grows suspicious when a woman he met online refuses to meet in person.

videos.title: Craig & Zoe
videos.overview: A man's online accounts are hacked by a woman he met on Facebook in the Season 3 premiere. After meeting Zoe on Facebook, she begins demanding passwords and hacking accounts.

videos.title: Antwane & Tony
videos.overview: Carmen is concerned about her cousin Antwane's 3-year romance with a man named Tony. Antwane lives a virtually pre-digital age existence making Tony's true identity difficult to reveal. Is Tony really who he says he is?

videos.title: Antoinette & Albert
videos.overview: A year after meeting "T-lights" on Instagram, "instaceleb" Antointette is ready to take things to the next level and meet "T-lights", but he always brushes off the idea. Is "T-lights" really the online celebrity he claims to be?

videos.title: Lucille & Kidd Cole
videos.overview: Lucille became affiliated with apparent recording artist Kidd Cole (who claims to have ties with Kanye West and his record label) and his co-manager Miguel who implicate her in a series of events that involve fat payments to the parties concerned.

videos.title: Tracie & Sammie
videos.overview: Tracie Thoms is an actress from Los Angeles, California who has encountered a super-crazy fan called Samantha on Twitter who creates fake profiles to garner more attention. She also initiated contact with a couple of other stars named Lotti and Marissa, using her bogus accounts under the name of Reese

videos.title: John & Kelsey
videos.overview: John met Kelsey Beelzebub, whose voice he has heard only once and whom he has never video chatted with, in a psychology chat room. Kelsey claims to have body dysmorphic disorder and anxiety.

videos.title: Solana & Elijah
videos.overview: Solana has been in a five-year relationship with Elijah, whom she met on MySpace, since she was 14. Elijah was her rock when she was coming to terms with her parents' divorce, but he abruptly goes off the radar. Around a couple of years later, he reaches out to her via a Facebook message, when Solana is in a relationship with Danny, but says that his gadget does not facilitate phone calls or video chat,so her must resort to a texting app

videos.title: Miranda & Cameryn
videos.overview: A woman searches for answers about a man she met online.

videos.title: Jeff & Megan
videos.overview: Red flags make a man question his relationship with a woman he met online.

videos.title: Bianca & Brogan
videos.overview: When Bianca met Brogan online everything was perfect until Brogan disappeared one day. A year later Brogan reappeared online and Bianca never questioned her. Can Biana find out what happened a year ago?

videos.title: Miracle & Javonni
videos.overview: Smart, single mom Miracle fell hard for Javonni, a dreamy-eyed Instagrammer. With Max on hiatus, Nev teams up with TV personality Charlamagne to take Miracle on a hunt for the man of her dreams

videos.title: Courtney & Catfish
videos.overview: Courtney previously cut things off with a man she met online. He won't let up, and is doing everything he can to reel Courtney back in. Cassidy Wolf joins Nev to make sure he leaves Courtney alone for good.

videos.title: Harold & Armani
videos.overview: Harold found his match with a beautiful jock named Armani. Although the two live in the same neighborhood, they've never met. Nev is joined by recording artist Angel Haze to help Harold finally get together with his girl.

videos.title: Daisy & Marcus
videos.overview: Daisy met Marcus on Instagram and he stole her heart, helping her get through troubles at home. But Marcus won't speak to Daisy on the phone or meet her in person, so Nev and YouTube star Tyler Oakley arrange a face to face.

videos.title: Chitara & Priscilla
videos.overview: A woman searches for answers when her relationship ends unexpectedly after she took a big leap and came out to her family.

videos.title: Felipe & Jasmine
videos.overview: A single father wants to settle down with his online love, but after eight months, they still have not met in person.

videos.title: Whitney & Bre
videos.overview: Nev and Max face a difficult situation when they meet Whitney.

videos.title: Jamey & Ari
videos.overview: After becoming involved with a fellow Texan online, a man will do anything to meet her.

videos.title: Blaire & Markie
videos.overview: A woman has to deal with some heartache from an instagram lover but she still wants to meet him.

videos.title: Steven & Samm
videos.overview: Rather than go to college, a man wants to relocate to California and support his online love.

videos.title: Tiana & James
videos.overview: A young woman moves across the country to be with her Internet love, but he is being elusive.

videos.title: Falesha & Jacqueline
videos.overview: Falesha’s name and pictures were stolen by a fake profile that nearly ruined her life. She thought her troubles were behind her, but four years later her past comes back to haunt her.

videos.title: Prophet & Trinity
videos.overview: Rapper R. Prophet hopes to learn the truth about Trinity, a model he met online.

videos.title: Thad & Sara
videos.overview: Thaddius sought refuge from his struggling marriage through an online relationship with Sara. But, when Sara starts telling strange tales of seizures and kidnappings, Thaddius starts to question her true identity.

videos.title: Andria & David
videos.overview: David is the only love Andria has ever known. His passionate love letters and voice messages have a way of making Andria stay. But having never met after 10 years, Andria needs to know what David is hiding.

videos.title: Ayissha & Sydney
videos.overview: Sydney and Ayissha were in an online romance for years before Sydney revealed she is not who she says. Even though she continues to lie about her identity, Ayissha is still in love with Sydney.

videos.title: Hundra & Emily
videos.overview: Hundra never planned on falling in love with a girl and now she is risking coming out on national TV to learn if her love with Emily is for real. Special guest Machine Gun Kelly teams with Nev to reveal a shocking Catfish.

videos.title: Devan & Rylan
videos.overview: A shy guy is concerned that his online love might not be marriage material because of her suspicious behavior.

videos.title: Brittany & Bryon
videos.overview: When Brittany, a single mom, finds love online with Bryon, a marine who may get deployed again to Iraq, she seeks Nev and Max’s help before she runs out of time.

videos.title: Dejay, Malik & Josiah
videos.overview: Nev and Max get two catfishes for the price of one when they discover that Dejay and Malik are being played by the same guy. Sparks fly as they discover just how explosive a love triangle can be.

videos.title: Jeanette & Derick
videos.overview: A concerned daughter asks for help when her mother begins contemplating marriage to a man she met online.

videos.title: Leuh & Justin
videos.overview: After two failed attempts to meet up with a surfer, a woman wants to find out if he is actually the man of her dreams.

videos.title: Brandon & McKenna
videos.overview: Karrueche Tran helps track down the truth when Brandon wonders whether his online love is real.

videos.title: Jaylin & Ja’la
videos.overview: Jaylin is prepared to sacrifice a lifelong friendship and promising videogame career to be with a woman he’s never even spoken to on the phone. Nev and Max help him discover that sometimes the truth is stranger than fiction.

videos.title: Michael & Chanelle
videos.overview: Michael felt he had no time for a relationship, but love appeared in a DM. Chanelle is the light he’s needed in his life, but out of the blue she's disappeared, leaving only Nev and Max to help him find his missing love.

videos.title: Ray & Lexi
videos.overview: Ray is determined to finally meet his online love of four years, Lexi. But after learning that Lexi’s sister has meddled in the relationship in the past, Nev and Max soon find themselves with more questions than answers.

videos.title: Joanna & Bo
videos.overview: Tattoo model, Joanna, was about to meet her online love in the flesh, but a crazy night in Vegas caused the whole relationship to go sour. Now she's enlisted Nev and Max to help track down her former flame and make things right.

videos.title: Tyreme & Tomorrow
videos.overview: Tyreme met the beautiful Tomorrow online over 9 months ago. They share a deep bond and Tyreme is ready to uproot his life to be with her. Will Nev and Max be able help Tyreme finally meet his Tomorrow?

videos.title: Kayla & Courtney
videos.overview: When Kayla was two, her father killed her mother and then later committed suicide. Years later, Kayla is sent a message from Courtney, a woman claiming to be channeling her dead father’s spirit.

videos.title: Paris & Tara
videos.overview: Paris enlists Nev and Max to help her figure out who has been catfishing her for the past four years. But as the guys investigate, they make a shocking discovery that casts suspicion onto Paris herself!

videos.title: Vince & Alyssa
videos.overview: Vince can’t seem to escape his online-ex, Alyssa, whose stalking has caused his real life girlfriend, Liz, to break up with him. Nev and Max help Vince confront Alyssa so he can try to salvage a future with Liz.

videos.title: Lucas & Many
videos.overview: When Jayme learns that her online boyfriend is fake and that he is catfishing other women as well, she enlists the help of Nev and Max to stop him.

videos.title: Larissa & Anthony
videos.overview: After being catfished by her best friend from high school, Larissa turns to another online friend for support.

videos.title: Spencer & Katy
videos.overview: Spencer reveals that he has been having a relationship with a pop star, and the Catfish team sets out to find the truth.

videos.title: Candic & Titus
videos.overview: After months of intimate text exchanges with a man she met online, named Titus, Candic has decided to finally stop and fess up to her husband. But before she does, she needs Nev and Max to help her find out who Titus really is!

videos.title: Andrea, Alex & Andrea
videos.overview: Fans of popular YouTube star, Andrea Russett, summon Nev and Max to help catch a potential stalker who is impersonating Andrea's family online. The guys soon uncover a web of fake profiles much larger than they thought possible.

videos.title: Catherine & Graham
videos.overview: Long Islander Catherine has fallen deeply in love with country boy Graham from Tennessee. She's ready to uproot her life to be a country girl with him, but Nev and Max uncover that Graham's not everything he claims to be.

videos.title: Luis & Sydney
videos.overview: Luis has fallen in love with a single mom who is down on her luck and now he's ready to take their online relationship to the next level. But first, Nev and Max must help investigate.

videos.title: Andrew & Zac
videos.overview: Andrew thought he met the perfect match on Tinder in Zac until he received a text message from a friend revealing shocking new information. As Nev and Max look into the case, they suspect Zac could be keeping a very big secret.

videos.title: Shawny & Jack
videos.overview: The Season 6 premiere, a newly single woman needs help uncovering the shadowy identity of a potential new love. But things get interesting when it's discovered that she may have secrets of her own.

videos.title: Alante & Nevaeh
videos.overview: Alante has spent the last eight years planning a life with his online love Nevaeh. She's perfect, but her disappearances have Alante worried. Nev and Max help to uncover a mysterious truth that affects Alante's entire town.

videos.title: Danny & Rosa
videos.overview: Danny is intent on building a family with his beautiful online love, despite her violent past. But when he enlists Nev and Max to help him finally meet her in person, they soon discover she may have ties to a former Catfish!

videos.title: Telizza & Shai
videos.overview: 18-year-old Telizza became bi-curious when her online friendship with Shai turned romantic. Frustrated by several failed attempts to video chat, Telizza has turned to Nev and Max to uncover the truth

videos.title: Marvin & Austin
videos.overview: After months of sexting with a hot model he met on a hookup app, Marvin is eager to meet him in person. Max and sidekick, singer Chantal Claret, agree to help Marvin find his crush, but soon uncover more than they bargained for!

videos.title: Mecca & Tanner
videos.overview: Max and co-host iO Tillett Wright help 18-year-old Mecca connect with the boy she's loved for the past 5 years. But when iO discovers that Mecca's digital beau may be using her pictures to catfish others, Mecca needs answers.

videos.title: Yasmine & Lewis
videos.overview: When Sandra learns that her granddaughter, Yasmine, sent money to a mysterious online boyfriend, she asks Nev and Max for help. As the guys look into the case, they discover there's much more that Yasmine has been hiding.

videos.title: Kailani & Sam
videos.overview: Kailani has fallen for Sam, her gay friend's online ex-boyfriend. Sam claims to love Kailani, but has been dodgy since she has tried to meet up with him. Nev and Max investigate Sam to help Kailani uncover what he is hiding.

videos.title: Ari & Lanum
videos.overview: Nev and Max receive emails from opposite sides of the same online romance, each concerned that the other may be a catfish; the guys react in surprise when one side decides to follow through with their marriage plans.

videos.title: Dylan & Ally
videos.overview: A man receives an anonymous text warning him that his online love is not who she says she is, and he seeks help from Nev and Max.

videos.title: Colleen & Tony
videos.overview: Colleen met Tony online and fell madly in love. Though they’ve never met, Tony proposed to Colleen over the phone and she accepted. Now, Nev and Max help her finally face the truth to reveal the mystery man she’s engaged to.

videos.title: Open Investigation
videos.overview: Nev and Max embark on the biggest case of their lives as they track down the infamous, Shelly Chartier, to uncover new truths as they investigate the celebrity catfishing of Paris Roxanne and NBA star, Chris "Birdman” Andersen.

videos.title: Johnny & Connor
videos.overview: After Jonathon’s online love disappears for a month, he enlists Nev and Max to help track him down. But when the guys discover a former catfish is involved, they begin to suspect Jonathon himself may be in on the deception!

videos.title: Kelsie & Brandon
videos.overview: Southern sweetheart Kelsie is madly in love with her online romeo, Brandon. But after years of endless excuses of why he cannot meet up, Kelsie recruits Nev and Max to go deep in the heart of Texas to find who Brandon really is.

videos.title: April & Dean
videos.overview: t’s been seven years since April met Dean in a chat room at the age of thirteen. During that time, Dean would often disappear for months at a time. Now, Nev and Max must help April find Dean before he disappears again.

videos.title: Robert & Ashleigh
videos.overview: After being paralyzed as a teenager, Robert met Ashleigh online and they fell in love. With news he may not have much longer to live, Robert asks Nev and Max to bring Ashleigh to him so he can find out if their love was real.

videos.title: Robin & Wayne
videos.overview: After three long years, Robin is desperate to finally meet her elusive, hunky, long-distance love in person. Nev and Max agree to help her hunt him down, but what they uncover turns out to be much more than Robin bargained for!

videos.title: Nicole & Nicole
videos.overview: For years, Nicole has had her pictures stolen to make fake profiles, one of which has been catfishing lovelorn Ryan, 27, for 10 years.

videos.title: Jose & Jay
videos.overview: Jasmine writes to Nev and Max asking for help for a “friend.” But they’re perplexed when Jasmine drops a bombshell revelation: they’ve helped her friend before.

videos.title: Caitlyn & Kenton
videos.overview: Young mother Caitlyn calls on Nev and Max to help separate the fact from fiction of her courtship with charming Facebook hunk, Kenton. Kenton insists she and her daughter move to Kentucky but is Kenton all that he claims to be?

videos.title: Sheklia & Talli
videos.overview: A concerned son reaches out when his mom's mysterious online boyfriend seems too shady for comfort, but Mom is hiding secrets of her own.

videos.title: Alyssa & Tyler
videos.overview: After a number of near-death experiences, Lawrence survived through it all with the assurance of Cierra's online love; but with Cierra blowing Lawrence off whenever they try to meet, Nev and Max must find the truth behind the suspicious profile.

videos.title: Kim & Matt

videos.overview: Comic Percy Rustomji joins Nev in helping Genesis find Jerison, a man she met 12 years ago on Facebook and with whom she recently reconnected.

videos.title: Ciatta & Juan
videos.overview: Ciatta has a bright family future planned with her perfect man Juan. But before Nev and Kamie give their blessings on Ciatta's move to LA to be with him, they uncover details on Juan that her life plans into question.

videos.title: Sasha & Essence
videos.overview: Sasha’s been in a wild flirtationship with Essence for years and is ready for the next level. Essence says she’s in an open relationship with her man, but Sasha feels like she is keeping a secret. Can Catfish help Sasha find out what Essence is hiding?

videos.title: Leanna & Jordan
videos.overview: Leanna fell so hard for Jordan that she sent him thousands of dollars! Though she's never met Jordan in person she did meet his cousin. Armed with only a sketch, Nev and Kamie go on a manhunt searching for the cousin.

videos.title: Jeni & Elijah
videos.overview: After a decade of not dating, Jeni fell hard for Elijah, but he won't meet and now his inconsistent photos of what he looks like are causing Jeni to be confused about who she's in love with.

videos.title: Kay & Tyreek
videos.overview: Kay found Tyreek online while looking for a friend, and little did she know he would end up becoming her first love, but after two years of never meeting, Kay's ready for answers.

videos.title: Mohammed & Ashley
videos.overview: Mohammed connected online with Ashley over business and spirituality. He’s developed strong feelings, but she keeps avoiding meeting up. Mohammed calls in the Catfish crew, and as soon as he shows them her photo, Nev and Kamie have upsetting news!

videos.title: Joey & Marrissa
videos.overview: The day Marrissa friended Joey was the day that changed everything for him. He thought he finally found a perfect woman but now, the only thing that has changed for Joey is his bank account, which Marrissa has almost emptied! Enter Catfish!

videos.title: Alaysia & Qua
videos.overview: Alaysia finds a kindred spirit in her supportive online boyfriend, Qua, but when Qua still won't meet her after almost a year of dating, Alaysia calls Nev and Kamie to help her find the truth.

videos.title: LeeAndre & Russia
videos.overview: Single dad LeeAndre seeks help after getting ghosted twice over the last few years by his virtual love, Russia, who he met in an IMVU virtual reality salon.

videos.title: Arturo & Laura
videos.overview: Arturo's girlfriend Laura is perfect! But after a year, she won't meet, videochat, or talk on the phone! He's wild about her, but Nev and Kamie smell a scam. Will Laura prove to be Arturo's true love? Or is she after something other than his heart?!

videos.title: Zahra & T
videos.overview: Max and Nēv rejoin forces to help Zahra discover the truth about T, a man she connected with on a fetish website and developed a romantic relationship with despite never meeting in person.

videos.title: Cristian & Chantel
videos.overview: Cristian fell hard for livestreamer Chantel, but on her live, she never shows her face! With Chantel evading Cristian, Nev and Kamie come up with a clever plan to get them to meet… but if Chantel loves him, why is she avoiding him.

videos.title: Kash & Kenya
videos.overview: Kash and Kenya fell in love after meeting on Instagram, but after two failed attempts at meeting in person, Kash seeks Nēv and Kamie's help to figure out what secrets Kenya may be hiding.

videos.title: Jeremy & Alex
videos.overview: In his small town, Jeremy struggled to find other gay men to date until Alex. But when Alex dropped a bombshell that he wasn't the man who Jeremy thought he was dating, Nev and guest co-host Arlissa dig deep for the crazy truth!

videos.title: Ayla & Gabby
videos.overview: Meeting online a year ago, Ayla experienced an instant connection with Gabby, bonding over their shared sickle-cell struggles. However, with Gabby refusing to meet or video chat, Nev and Kamie feel that Gabby might not be the real soulmate.

videos.title: Omar & Iris
videos.overview: Iris is stunningly beautiful and a nerd too; Omar thinks he found the perfect girl, but when Nev and Kamie arrive to help Omar, they have concerns.

videos.title: Sebastian & Allison
videos.overview: Sebastian talks to Allison for over three years, but she refuses to ever video chat; when he tells her he plans to move closer to her, Allison pulls back; Nev and Kamie suspect Allison hides something.

videos.title: Reign & Piers
videos.overview: Young Reign fell fast for Piers, forming a deep connection after meeting in an anime fandom group. Now, 7 years later, after a long absence, Piers is back in her DMs! Reign enlists the help of Nev and Kamie to find Piers.
